Inside

Seven short parts.

It is a worksheet, not a lecture. Each part ends with something you fill in on your own listing.

  1. The methodYes, Partly, No: how to mark a listing honestly
  2. Security readerQuestions 1–3, what a good answer holds and what to leave out
  3. Procurement readerQuestions 4–6, with the pricing-unit worksheet
  4. Technical readerQuestions 7–9, with the setup-sentence template
  5. AI search readerQuestions 10–12, with the first-twenty-words test
  6. Rewrite rulesSeven rules and the word list we cut
  7. Self-score sheetYour “answers X of 12” count and what to do with it
No catch. The playbook uses the same method as the paid audit. Doing it yourself is a fair outcome; if you would rather have it done and written for you, Listing Optimize is $500.
